title: Check the representer theorem and build random features
brief: Evaluate the regularised objective for a candidate with extra centres, build random Fourier features for the RBF kernel, and fit ridge regression on them.
hints: representer_check evaluates one formula: the summed squared error on the first len(y) entries of K @ coeffs, plus lam * coeffs @ K @ coeffs. It works for any list of centres K was built from.

For random_fourier_features, draw omega with shape (D, d) from a normal distribution scaled by sqrt(2 * gamma), and D phases uniform on [0, 2 pi). Test points must reuse the same draw, so take all randomness from the rng you are given and shapes that depend only on D and d.
ridge_on_features solves the D by D system (Z^T Z + lam I) w = Z^T y. Use np.linalg.solve; it needs no inverse.
